case_description: One complete P2PANEL used alone for a State population estimate
factual_conclusion: FIA assumes complete spatial coverage for each panel and states single-panel estimation proceeds by standard design-based methods.
caveat_or_requirement: Higher variance/small within-stratum n; in subpaneling work units a complete P2PANEL can span two scheduled subpanels/years.

case_description: One SUBPANEL alone in RMRS/PNWRS/affected Oklahoma
factual_conclusion: Current schema identifies annual subpanels but D09B found no core nationwide statement equating one subpanel with the complete-panel estimator of Chapter 5.
caveat_or_requirement: Do not silently substitute SUBPANEL for P2PANEL without a bounded design audit.

case_description: Combine selected complete panels by moving average
factual_conclusion: FIA officially describes MA: independent panel estimates combined with positive weights summing to one; panel variances combine with squared weights.
caveat_or_requirement: Temporal average/lag depends on weights and panel years.

case_description: Pool selected complete panels under common Phase-1 stratification
factual_conclusion: FIA officially describes TI pooling panels into one periodic-inventory-like sample and applying standard post-stratified estimation.
caveat_or_requirement: TI is temporally indifferent and does not target a specific year.

case_description: Retain only selected panels but use full-evaluation EXPNS unchanged
factual_conclusion: Full-evaluation expansion quantities depend on effective stratum sample sizes; changing the sample invalidates automatic reuse.

case_description: Multiply full-evaluation weights by a single global 5/k factor
factual_conclusion: No FIA core method documents this as a universal transformation; exact only under restrictive equal-retention conditions across all design strata.

case_description: A 2-panel fold and a 3-panel fold each estimate the population total
factual_conclusion: Each complete-panel subset can support design-based estimation after correct weights/variance, but precision differs and temporal composition generally differs.
caveat_or_requirement: Same spatial population does not imply identical time-point estimand.

factual_conclusion: Outcome-blind and preserves complete panels, but not an FIA-prescribed A/B rule; 3-vs-2 imbalance and panel-year coupling can create temporal imbalance.
caveat_or_requirement: Subpaneling makes P2PANEL nonannual in Western work units.

case_description: Deterministic whole-panel partition balancing design-level plot/stratum representation
factual_conclusion: May improve fold balance while preserving whole panels; FIA does not prescribe this cross-fitting rule.
caveat_or_requirement: Must use design-only variables, never species outcomes; temporal balance still needs audit.

case_description: Allow different whole-panel partitions by State
factual_conclusion: Regional panel/subpanel schedules differ, so a State-specific design audit is defensible; no FIA core A/B prescription exists.
caveat_or_requirement: Mainline must freeze a deterministic reproducible rule.

case_description: Combine State-specific fold estimates to a CONUS total
factual_conclusion: FIA design-based framework combines independent estimation-unit/State totals and variances after valid within-State estimates.
caveat_or_requirement: Each State must use its own coherent evaluation and fold-specific design bookkeeping.

case_description: Use fold A panels for support and fold B panels for abundance, then reverse
factual_conclusion: Disjoint complete panels are probability-sample-aligned, but Q1 cross-fitting is not an FIA-prescribed estimator.
caveat_or_requirement: Requires fold-specific weights/variance and explicit temporal estimand.

case_description: Require no permanent plot lineage in both folds
factual_conclusion: Panel assignment is intended as persistent spatial design membership, so whole-panel splitting should enforce disjoint lineages; historical exceptions should be checked.

case_description: Treat P2PANEL values 1-5 as one annual sample per value in every State
factual_conclusion: Current FIADB SUBPANEL definition shows P2PANEL is subdivided in RMRS, PNWRS and parts of Oklahoma.
caveat_or_requirement: P2PANEL number is not a nationally synchronized year label.

case_description: Assume every CONUS State has a whole-State 2023 evaluation group
factual_conclusion: Current FIADB-API metadata lacks 2023 whole-State groups for Montana, New Mexico and Utah; their latest published groups are 2022.
caveat_or_requirement: Mainline exception rule required before D08C2.

case_description: Derive each panel's measurement year from evaluation-group member-year list
factual_conclusion: wc metadata lists member years but not P2PANEL/SUBPANEL-to-year membership.
caveat_or_requirement: Needs bounded local PLOT-level design audit.

case_description: Treat whole-State Texas group 482023 as one guessed numeric EVALID
factual_conclusion: Official wc metadata confirms group 482023, but FIADB update history records separate East and West 482023 components. Group membership must be read from POP_EVAL_TYP/POP_EVAL; a guessed single EVALID is not justified.
caveat_or_requirement: Bounded local design-metadata audit before D08C2; no species outcomes required.
